prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint changes showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Home wait info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption incentive, adoption layout, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop companion launchpad redesign for home intro: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight launchpad layout featuring a mascot highlight and clear launch button. (why: Finish completion rate is low at 64.8% with mean duration of 5815s. A dedicated launchpad layout clarifies how to bring the pet onto the desktop.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account pet save clarity headline on sign-in: Updates sign-in headline and body to highlight pet backup and progress preservation. (why: Support logs show 8 complaints about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, layout] Grid pet selection layout on pick friend screen: Switches pick_friend screen layout to a visual grid format for quick pet side-by-side comparison. (why: Adoption conversion is 68.5% with median time 89s. A grid layout helps users pick their companion faster.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop pet interaction quick key hint: Displays a clear hint on home_intro explaining shortcut controls and context menu options for the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop ready audio notification on waiting screen: Triggers an audio completion notification sound when pet rendering finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time on home is 2336s, indicating users tab away during long setup times and fail to return.)
